name: Valencia Marathon Trinidad Alfonso Zurich
summary: Cheer at Paseo de la Alameda (km 14 and 25), Plaza del Ayuntamiento, Plaza de Tetuán and Porta de la Mar (km 29 and 40), then catch the finish over the water at the City of Arts and Sciences.
heroNote: Runners pass Paseo de la Alameda at km 14 and again at km 25, and Plaza de Tetuán (km 29) is a short walk from Porta de la Mar (km 40). After the finish, the official meeting points are the Palau de les Arts roundabout, the Aqua shopping centre roundabout and next to El Saler shopping centre.
